newsitem.title: GERMANY: Henkel takes rest of stake in Schwarzkopf.
newsitem.headline: Henkel takes rest of stake in Schwarzkopf.

text.p: German speciality chemicals group Henkel KGaA said Thursday it plans to acquire the remaining 23 percent of consumer products group Hans Schwarzkopf that it does not already own.

Henkel, which two weeks ago scored a strategic coup when it acquired the remaining minority stake of U.S. adhesives group Loctite Corp. for about $1.3 billion, took over a majority stake in Schwarzkopf from Hoechst AG last summer.
Since then, Schwarzkopf, boasting one of Germany's best-selling shampoos, has helped Henkel boost its results considerably.
Henkel declined to reveal the purchase price for the Schwarzkopf stake. The family-owners of Schwarzkopf have swapped their shares for Henkel common shares.
Analysts said the acquisitions put Henkel in a much stronger position in terms of geography and products.
